map.根据燃油消耗量与排放因子估算 CO₂。: Estimate CO₂ from fuel consumption and an emission factor.
map.CO₂ = 燃油量 × 排放因子（汽油约 2.31）: CO₂ = fuel volume × emission factor (about 2.31 for petrol)
map.柴油因子约 2.68 kgCO₂/L。: The diesel factor is about 2.68 kgCO₂/L.
map.车队核算：录入柴油/汽油耗量，求年碳排放。: Fleet accounting: enter diesel or petrol consumption to obtain annual carbon emissions.
map.设备排放：对工程机械录入油耗，估施工期排放。: Equipment emissions: enter fuel use for construction machinery to estimate emissions over the construction period.
map.教学演示：演示汽油(约2.3)、柴油(约2.7)因子差异。: Teaching demo: show the difference between the petrol (about 2.3) and diesel (about 2.7) factors.
map.示例：年耗柴油 5000 L、因子 2.68 kgCO₂/L，排放=5000×2: Example: 5000 L of diesel per year at 2.68 kgCO₂/L gives emissions = 5000×2.68 = 13400 kg = 13.4 tCO₂.
map.燃料碳含量不同，汽油约 2.3、柴油约 2.7、航煤约 2.5 kgCO₂/L。: Because the carbon content differs: about 2.3 for petrol, about 2.7 for diesel and about 2.5 kgCO₂/L for jet fuel. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.燃烧排放因子已含氧化过程；处理装置改变局部污染物，对 CO2 影响小。结果按公开: The combustion emission factor already covers the oxidation process; after-treatment changes local pollutants but has little effect on CO₂. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.和电力碳比？: How does it compare with electricity?
map.同能量下燃油直接排放计入范围一，电力为范围二，口径不同勿混。结果按公开标准与环境: For the same energy, direct fuel emissions count as Scope 1 while electricity is Scope 2; the boundaries differ and must not be mixed. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
